Ancestor worship is a central element of [[alpha teachings]] and in particular [[Commandment Alpha Omega]]. 

It is a difficult thing to establish without also promoting racism, or other exclusionary attitudes. 

A proposed scheme for ancestor worship was the [[Five Ancestors]] but it proved impractical.
